name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button's disabled state is not reset after a failed export, which aligns with the maintainers' policy of treating fixes for this component as feature requests. The issue describes a UI behavior that requires intentional design changes to handle errors gracefully.

input.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export by resetting busy state on failure
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The issue is that the `busy` state is only reset in the `.then()` callback of `exportReport`, which is never called if the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx HTTP response). This leaves the button disabled indefinitely. To fix this, the `catch` block of the `exportReport` promise should also reset `busy` to `false` and show an error toast. This ensures the button is re-enabled after a failed export attempt.
